span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Threshold nonlinearity in a convergent network converts the linear suppression type: suppressed inputs falling below the output neuron's spiking threshold turn subtractive inhibition of single neurons into divisive inhibition of the network, and vice versa
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Because most cortical input to a neuron is intracortical, activating interneurons changes the firing of the neuron's own converging and recurrent inputs, adding a second-order effect on top of the direct linear effect on that neuron
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Rectification of input firing rates (rates cannot go negative) makes subtractive suppression act most strongly at each input neuron's preferred frequency, which the connectivity function then passes on as a divisive-looking loss of drive at the target's best frequency
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: most cortical input is intracortical, so changing inhibition changes the firing of a neuron's own inputs as well as the neuron, producing effects single-neuron models do not predict
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: in a network model, threshold nonlinearities plus the strength of suppression of a cell's inputs determine whether the observed effect looks divisive, subtractive or both
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the character of suppression in downstream neurons is set by their own thresholds and connections rather than by what happened upstream
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: further sources of the same masking are available: interneurons are themselves tuned and receive organised excitation, and many types inhibit one another
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: local subnetworks with different intrinsic or connectional properties can interpret the same inhibition differently
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Both interneuron populations were driven nonselectively and with diffuse timing, unlike their natural recruitment, so type-specific functional differences may have been washed out.
span.note: what this limits: what the optogenetic experiment tests: BOTH POPULATIONS OF INTERNEURONS WERE ACTIVATED IN A NONSELECTIVE AND TEMPORALLY DIFFUSE MANNER, unlike their recruitment during normal brain operation
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Optogenetic stimulation parameters were not matched between the awake and anesthetized preparations.
span.note: what this limits: the awake-versus-anaesthetised comparison: SOME OF THE OPTOGENETIC PARAMETERS (LIGHT STRENGTH, OPTICAL FIBER DIAMETER) WERE NOT IDENTICAL BETWEEN the two preparations
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The proposed network mechanism is only one of several possible routes to the masking effect, and the paper does not exclude the others it lists.
span.note: what this limits: the proposed network mechanism: THIS SECOND-ORDER EFFECT OF INHIBITORY ACTIVITY ON EXCITATORY TUNING IS MERELY ONE AMONG MANY MECHANISMS BY WHICH THIS MASKING PHENOMENON MAY EMERGE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: both interneuron populations were driven nonselectively and diffusely in time, so differences arising from their natural response dynamics would not appear here

span.label: divisive —contrasted-with→ subtractive
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — CRITERION, AND IT IS A FIT: slope of one with a negative intercept is subtractive, slope below one with a zero intercept is divisive. Both are parameters of a regression, not observations

span.label: RETRACTED (NOT A CONTAINMENT RELATION) · Sst —part-of→ dendrites
span.note: RETRACTED: NOT A CONTAINMENT RELATION. Sst is not part of dendrites. The span says Sst-expressing interneuron subtypes 'avoid synapsing onto excitatory neurons' somata and instead FORM CONTACTS ON their (mainly distal) DENDRITES' - a connectivity relation, which none of the eight types carries. Reversing it would be as wrong as leaving it. RE-SUPPLIED: this retraction was silently lost on 2026-08-15 because its batch carried two entries for one record (Q-251). — strength of the relation: 1 — and the anatomy is what generates the prediction that this class should be subtractive
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (NOT A CONTAINMENT RELATION, same shape as [1]) · Pvalb —part-of→ soma
span.note: RETRACTED: NOT A CONTAINMENT RELATION, same shape as [1]. Pvalb is not part of a soma. The span says Pvalb-expressing subtypes have axons that form 'baskets,' ENFOLDING THE SOMA - again a connectivity relation between a cell class and the compartment it targets. — strength of the relation: 1
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: soma —causes→ input resistance
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — MECHANISM OF THE PREDICTION: inhibition near the soma lowers effective input resistance, so proportionately larger currents are needed to reach threshold - hence divisive
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: dendrites —distinct-from→ input resistance
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS ELECTROTONIC DISTANCE, AND THE MECHANISM IS GIVEN. 'Quotation withheld.' The same conductance has a different effect depending only on WHERE it is placed, so a result about inhibition is uninterpretable without the location - and the location is usually not what a synapse type is named for. Q-476. · strength of the relation: 1 — and the mirror image: dendritic inhibition does not decrease somatic resistance, which is why it should subtract
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: interneuron —part-of→ network
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — THE LEVEL ERROR IN ONE SENTENCE: network interactions determine the systems-level effects of neuron-level manipulations, and that is what makes the literature look contradictory
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: threshold —causes→ divisive
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — in the model, varying threshold and the strength of input suppression alone moves the apparent effect between divisive, subtractive and both
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: network —causes→ suppression
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — the character of suppression downstream is set by the downstream cell's own properties, whatever happened upstream - hence 'masked'
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: in vitro —distinct-from→ suppression
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — THE PREPARATION IS THE KEY: the two classes are easily distinguishable in vitro and indistinguishable in vivo, and that is the finding rather than a discrepancy to explain away
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Sst —causes→ bandwidth
span.note: strength of the relation: 1 — SIGN: narrowing - and by the same amount as Pvalb, so bandwidth does not separate the classes either
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (`g-test --operationalised-as--> suppression`) · g-test —operationalised-as→ suppression
span.note: RETRACTED: `g-test --operationalised-as--> suppression`. And the span is the same null result from which [5] was retracted this morning: 'The proportions of suppression types ... Quotation withheld (G-TEST P = 0.54).' One sentence, two bad edges of two types - the second found by meta-claude's rule after the neighbour query had already been over this record. A STATISTICAL TEST IS NOT AN OPERATIONALISATION OF ANYTHING. It is applied TO measurements; it does not constitute one. On this schema `operationalised-as` names a measurement or definition OF THE FROM ENDPOINT, so a test name in the `from` slot asserts that the test is measured by the other term. meta-claude, 2026-08-15, and MEASURED BEFORE BUILDING: five live edges carry a test name at an endpoint, all five are `operationalised-as`, and ALL FOUR WITH THE TEST IN THE `from` SLOT ARE WRONG. Q-408. — strength of the relation: 0.8
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (THE SPAN ASSERTS SIMILARITY, THE EDGE ASSERTS CONTRAST) · anesthetized —contrasted-with→ awake
span.note: RETRACTED: THE SPAN ASSERTS SIMILARITY, THE EDGE ASSERTS CONTRAST. 'The SIMILARITY of the data in the anesthetized and the awake preparation, DESPITE the fact that some of the optogenetic parameters (light strength, optical fiber diameter) were not identical between the two conditions, suggests that this masking may be relatively...' - the authors are arguing that the two preparations gave the SAME result even though the methods differed, which is the opposite of the contrast the edge records. Third instance of this shape tonight, after Murray2017 and Alkire2008[13]. — strength of the relation: 0.4 — the record marks this weak — AND THEY AGREED, despite differing optogenetic parameters, which is what makes the masking look robust rather than preparation-specific
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Optogenetically activating either somatostatin- or parvalbumin-positive interneurons produced a mixture of divisive and subtractive suppression of auditory cortical tone responses, and neurons recorded at the same time were often suppressed in qualitatively different ways.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The proportions of divisive, subtractive, mixed and neither-type suppression were statistically indistinguishable between Sst+ and Pvalb+ activation, contradicting the standard prediction that Pvalb+ cells divide and Sst+ cells subtract.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: About half of suppressed units showed divisive-only suppression (slope below 1 with intercept not below 0), with the remainder split between subtractive-only, mixed, and neither, for both interneuron families.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A threshold-linear (slope-plus-intercept) description captured most of the variance of suppression for both interneuron types, so the suppression of individual neurons was well described as a linear transformation.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Activating either interneuron family narrowed the frequency tuning bandwidths of other units in anesthetized mice, and the bandwidth changes did not differ between the two families.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Slope, intercept and bandwidth changes were uncorrelated across pairs of neurons recorded simultaneously on the same probe, showing that neurons in one cortical column are not affected uniformly by the same interneuron activation.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: In the network model, divisive suppression of inputs and subtractive suppression of inputs both produce divisive-like suppression of the net drive reaching a downstream neuron, because rectification makes subtractive suppression bite hardest at each input's preferred frequency.

span.label: In the model, the observed suppression type of a downstream neuron was set by its own spiking threshold and the overall strength of suppression of its inputs rather than by whether its inputs were suppressed divisively or subtractively, so an interneuron type's signature is masked by network and cellular properties.

The cited name is the subject of a result verb and the sentence carries no first-person marker, so the finding, quantity or definition is the CITED author's rather than this record's. The claim is true and the quote is verbatim - what is wrong is whose result the corpus says it is. Nothing edited, nothing withdrawn: the row is marked so a page can name the source. Where the record is a commentary or review, its `claim_relations` layer usually already names the paper being discussed - the record knows at one layer and forgets at another.
